title: Round robin gives tickets to an agent whose Email channel is off
label: BUG vs ZOHO
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · Dept QA AS6 Dept A, rule QA AS6 RR seq (Sequential, A1/A2/A3) · Zoho Desk org techsolutionsegypt (Enterprise trial, admin)

panels.caption: TAVI: ticket #1122 → History. Owner Mahmoud Samy (A2), whose Email channel was OFF
Zoho: Setup → Assignment Rules → Round Robin → ⋯ → Round Robin Preferences (opened, closed with Cancel)

rows: Only agents who are online in the mail channel, unless "Assign tickets to offline agents" is on.

"Assign tickets to offline agents" was OFF. A2 was signed in (online: true) but had the Email channel switched off (channels.email: false). Round robin still gave A2 its normal turn: 3 tickets went A3, A1, A2 (#1122 to A2). With all three agents on Email off, the ticket was still assigned (to A3) instead of staying in the backlog.
Zoho docs (not shown on this screen): agents who go offline or reach their threshold are marked SKIPPED and moved to the end of the queue.
History shows "Assigned automatically … Assigned to Mahmoud Samy" with no skipped agent. Only a full sign-out (online: false) makes round robin skip the agent (checked: SKIPPED shown).
